nonblocking.what: fake-worker/worker.py:190-194 only checks that TEMP is a directory inside the write_temp_files loop; real dsh checks on every launch. Under the B1 mutant the honest run still ends RUN.result=pass and is caught only by the harness assertion. Move the TEMP is_dir check to the top of main() so the stand-in is as strict as dsh for every node.

The honest assertion labelled 'outside_workspace 是**算出来的**（不是写死 True）' only checks ==True. pick_sandbox_root die(2)s on overlap, so a finished run can never have False, and the assertion cannot tell computed from hard-coded. Either rename the label or add a unit test of the computed path (e.g. call _overlaps directly or mutate the expression to True and confirm a red).

The exists assertions at runner-harness.py:675 (parallel-check) and :849 (retrythenok) compare against [True]*len(attempts) and pass vacuously when attempts is empty; honest has a len>=3 guard, these two do not.
